mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the transporter brought the chapter together: the cell made a protein that changed what could cross its boundary.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate channel and pump fittings felt repetitive, and their results added little explanation of how the two routes differ.

surprise.text: The messenger RNA result clearly showed that DNA stays in the nucleus while a working copy carries instructions to a ribosome.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the folding and targeting machinery combined several processes without much explanation.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the cell connects to tissues and body systems, though I would hope for more explanation alongside the fittings.
